title: Full-length transcriptome assembly of black amur bream (Megalobrama terminalis) as a reference resource.
one_liner_zh: 该文为黑鲂全长转录组组装与注释，纯测序与表达分析，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: The genus Megalobrama holds significant economic value in China, with M. terminalis (Black Amur bream) ranking second in production within this group. However, lacking comprehensive genomic and transcriptomic data has impeded research progress. This study aims to fill this gap through an extensive transcriptomic analysis of M. terminalis. METHODS AND RESULTS: We utilized PacBio Isoform Sequencing to generate 558,998 subreads, totaling 45.52 Gb, which yielded 22,141 transcripts after rigorous filtering and clustering. Complementary Illumina short-read sequencing corrected 967,114 errors across these transcripts. Our analysis identified 12,426 non-redundant isoforms, with 11,872 annotated in various databases. Functional annotation indicated 11,841 isoforms matched entries in the NCBI non-redundant protein sequences database. Gene Ontology analysis categorized 10,593 isoforms, revealing strong associations with cellular processes and binding functions. Additionally, 8203 isoforms were mapped to pathways in the Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes, highlighting significant involvement in immune system processes and complement cascades. We notably identified key immune molecules such as alpha-2-macroglobulin and complement component 3, each with multiple isoforms, underscoring their potential roles in the immune response. Our analysis also uncovered 853 alternative splicing events, predominantly involving retained introns, along with 672 transcription factors and 426 long non-coding RNAs. CONCLUSIONS: The high-quality reference transcriptome generated in this study provides a valuable resource for comparative genomic studies within the Megalobrama genus, supporting future research to enhance aquaculture stocks.
abstract_zh: 背景：鲂属（Megalobrama）在中国具有重要经济价值，其中黑鲂（M. terminalis，黑鲂）在该属中产量排名第二。然而，缺乏全面的基因组和转录组数据阻碍了研究进展。本研究旨在通过黑鲂的广泛转录组分析来填补这一空白。方法与结果：我们利用PacBio Isoform Sequencing生成了558,998个亚读段，总计45.52 Gb，经过严格过滤和聚类后获得22,141个转录本。互补的Illumina短读段测序纠正了这些转录本中的967,114个错误。我们的分析鉴定出12,426个非冗余异构体，其中11,872个在各种数据库中进行了注释。功能注释显示，11,841个异构体与NCBI非冗余蛋白质序列数据库中的条目匹配。基因本体论分析对10,593个异构体进行了分类，揭示其与细胞过程和结合功能密切相关。此外，8,203个异构体被映射到京都基因与基因组百科全书的通路中，突出显示其在免疫系统过程和补体级联反应中的显著参与。我们特别鉴定了关键免疫分子，如α-2-巨球蛋白和补体成分3，每种均具有多个异构体，强调其在免疫反应中的潜在作用。我们的分析还发现了853个可变剪接事件，主要涉及内含子保留，以及672个转录因子和426个长链非编码RNA。结论：本研究生成的高质量参考转录组为鲂属内的比较基因组研究提供了宝贵资源，支持未来增强水产养殖种群的研究。
